editorial_rationale: Conventions influence how abstractions are expressed in a language.
State change versus prohibiting mutation of a value.
Runtime state mutation is not source-code mutation for test assessment.
Atomic primitives coordinate access to shared state under concurrency.
Atomic access affects data-race analysis for a location.
Atomic shared-memory operations and ACID transaction atomicity have different scopes.
Interleaving progress differs from physical simultaneous execution.
Blocking behavior is one I/O execution property.
Nonblocking behavior is one I/O execution property.
RFC 9110 defines idempotency for HTTP request methods.
Safe retry of a logical operation is different from indivisible memory access.
Transactions can support durable duplicate suppression but do not guarantee it alone.
Webhook consumers must consider duplicate delivery.
MVCC can underpin transaction isolation implementations.
OWASP offers guidance on assessing application attack surfaces.
Untrusted tool results can carry prompt-injection attempts.
Distributed traces are one form of observability telemetry.
